claims.text: In 2021-2025, age-standardised cancer mortality in West Uusimaa wellbeing services county was 3.7% below the national level (ratio 0.963, 95% interval 0.937-0.99), about 35.1 fewer deaths a year than its age structure predicts.

Proportion of women invited to breast cancer screening (mammography) who attended, %: West Uusimaa wellbeing services county is at 76.27 (three-year mean to 2024) against 81.6 nationally and a target of 80.
Among the stages that public data can measure, the earliest one where West Uusimaa wellbeing services county is clearly worse than the country is early detection (screening participation).

Time from referral to diagnosis and from diagnosis to first treatment is not published by county for any cancer, so the Goal 3 indicator "patients access treatment within the established target times" cannot be checked from open data.

Proportion of women invited to cervical cancer screening (smear test) who attended, %: 72.8% against the 80% target. HPV self-sampling kits for cervical screening non-attenders is expected to add 1.5-4.5 percentage points, closing about 42% of the gap.

Proportion of invited to colorectal cancer screening who attended, %: 73.4% against the 80% target. Reminder and multilingual re-invitation for colorectal screening is expected to add 1.5-4.5 percentage points, closing about 45% of the gap.
First step for every county: Add first contact, referral, diagnosis and first treatment dates, plus entry route, to the national cancer quality register and publish county-level medians quarterly.
